text.releaseNotes:
Added a Blueprint Macro that provides a guided way to create new pages from predefined templates or blueprint-like structures. It is designed to reduce manual page setup, improve consistency, and make structured content creation easier for end users. The Blueprint Macro brings the Blueprint Creator experience into Properties, making it even easier to migrate from the DC-only Blueprint Creator to Properties Cloud.

  • Standardizes page creation
  • Reduces setup time for recurring content
  • Brings template-driven creation closer to the user’s point of work
  • Supports more discoverable create flows on pages

Marketing teams 📣

Business teams 🛠️
